commands.command:
set -eu
install -d -m 0700 /var/lib/etc-integrity
cat > /usr/local/sbin/etc-integrity <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
umask 077

state_dir=/var/lib/etc-integrity
baseline="$state_dir/etc.sha256"
mode=${1:---check}
tmp=$(mktemp "$state_dir/current.XXXXXX")
report=$(mktemp "$state_dir/report.XXXXXX")
trap 'rm -f "$tmp" "$report"' EXIT HUP INT TERM

find /etc -xdev -type f -exec sha256sum '{}' ';' | LC_ALL=C sort > "$tmp"

case "$mode" in
  --init)
    install -m 0600 "$tmp" "$baseline"
    printf 'Initialized /etc integrity baseline: %s files, %s\n' "$(wc -l < "$baseline")" "$baseline"
    ;;
  --check)
    if [ ! -r "$baseline" ]; then
      printf 'ERROR: baseline missing: %s (run %s --init)\n' "$baseline" "$0" >&2
      exit 2
    fi
    if diff -u --label baseline/etc.sha256 --label current/etc.sha256 "$baseline" "$tmp" > "$report"; then
      printf 'OK: /etc integrity baseline matches (%s files checked)\n' "$(wc -l < "$tmp")"
    else
      printf 'WARNING: /etc integrity drift detected\n'
      cat "$report"
      logger -t etc-integrity 'WARNING: /etc integrity drift detected; run /usr/local/sbin/etc-integrity --check for details'
      exit 1
    fi
    ;;
  *)
    printf 'Usage: %s [--check|--init]\n' "$0" >&2
    exit 2
    ;;
esac
ANTRIEB_EOF
chmod 0755 /usr/local/sbin/etc-integrity
cat > /etc/periodic/daily/etc-integrity <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
#!/bin/sh
exec /usr/local/sbin/etc-integrity --check
ANTRIEB_EOF
chmod 0755 /etc/periodic/daily/etc-integrity
ls -l /usr/local/sbin/etc-integrity /etc/periodic/daily/etc-integrity /var/lib/etc-integrity

before=$(sha256sum "$target" | awk '{print $1}')
printf '\nintegrity verification marker\n' >> "$target"
printf 'Check after modifying existing file %s:\n' "$target"
/usr/local/sbin/etc-integrity --check
changed_status=$?
restore
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
after=$(sha256sum "$target" | awk '{print $1}')
printf 'modified_check_exit=%s\noriginal_sha256=%s\nrestored_sha256=%s\n' "$changed_status" "$before" "$after"
printf '\nFinal clean check:\n'
/usr/local/sbin/etc-integrity --check
clean_status=$?
printf 'final_clean_exit=%s\n' "$clean_status"
if [ "$changed_status" -ne 1 ] || [ "$clean_status" -ne 0 ] || [ "$before" != "$after" ]; then exit 1; fi
